WITH BusinessGlossary AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        VALUES
            (
                'internet_sales_revenue',
                'Internet Sales Revenue',
                'measure',
                'Internet Sales Revenue is calculated as SUM(FactInternetSales.SalesAmount). SalesAmount excludes TaxAmt and Freight. Unless the user explicitly requests tax or freight, do not add those fields to revenue.',
                'SUM(fis.SalesAmount)',
                'dbo.FactInternetSales'
            ),
            (
                'gross_product_profit',
                'Gross Product Profit',
                'measure',
                'Gross Product Profit is calculated as Internet Sales Revenue minus Total Product Cost. It excludes tax, freight, operating expenses, and other overhead. It should not be described as net profit.',
                'SUM(fis.SalesAmount - fis.TotalProductCost)',
                'dbo.FactInternetSales'
            ),
            (
                'gross_margin_percentage',
                'Gross Margin Percentage',
                'measure',
                'Gross Margin Percentage is Gross Product Profit divided by Internet Sales Revenue, multiplied by 100. Use NULLIF to prevent division by zero.',
                '100.0 * SUM(fis.SalesAmount - fis.TotalProductCost) / NULLIF(SUM(fis.SalesAmount), 0)',
                'dbo.FactInternetSales'
            ),
            (
                'internet_order_count',
                'Internet Order Count',
                'measure',
                'Internet Order Count is the distinct count of SalesOrderNumber. Do not use COUNT(*) because FactInternetSales contains one row per sales order line.',
                'COUNT(DISTINCT fis.SalesOrderNumber)',
                'dbo.FactInternetSales'
            ),
            (
                'units_sold',
                'Units Sold',
                'measure',
                'Units Sold is the sum of OrderQuantity across Internet sales order lines.',
                'SUM(fis.OrderQuantity)',
                'dbo.FactInternetSales'
            ),
            (
                'average_order_value',
                'Average Order Value',
                'measure',
                'Average Order Value is Internet Sales Revenue divided by distinct Internet Order Count. Use NULLIF to prevent division by zero.',
                'SUM(fis.SalesAmount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT fis.SalesOrderNumber), 0)',
                'dbo.FactInternetSales'
            ),
            (
                'unique_customer_count',
                'Unique Customer Count',
                'measure',
                'Unique Customer Count is the distinct count of CustomerKey appearing in FactInternetSales for the requested filters.',
                'COUNT(DISTINCT fis.CustomerKey)',
                'dbo.FactInternetSales'
            ),
            (
                'order_date',
                'Order Date',
                'date_role',
                'Order Date is the date on which an Internet sales order was placed. Join FactInternetSales.OrderDateKey to DimDate.DateKey. Use Order Date unless the user explicitly requests due date or ship date.',
                'fis.OrderDateKey = d.DateKey',
                'dbo.FactInternetSales,dbo.DimDate'
            ),
            (
                'product_category',
                'Product Category',
                'dimension',
                'Product Category is the highest product classification. Navigate from FactInternetSales to DimProduct, then DimProductSubcategory, and finally DimProductCategory.',
                'FactInternetSales -> DimProduct -> DimProductSubcategory -> DimProductCategory',
                'dbo.FactInternetSales,dbo.DimProduct,dbo.DimProductSubcategory,dbo.DimProductCategory'
            ),
            (
                'customer_geography',
                'Customer Geography',
                'dimension',
                'Customer Geography describes the geographic attributes of the customer. Navigate from FactInternetSales to DimCustomer and then DimGeography.',
                'FactInternetSales -> DimCustomer -> DimGeography',
                'dbo.FactInternetSales,dbo.DimCustomer,dbo.DimGeography'
            ),
            (
                'sales_territory',
                'Sales Territory',
                'dimension',
                'Sales Territory classifies Internet sales by territory, country, and group. Join FactInternetSales.SalesTerritoryKey directly to DimSalesTerritory.SalesTerritoryKey.',
                'fis.SalesTerritoryKey = st.SalesTerritoryKey',
                'dbo.FactInternetSales,dbo.DimSalesTerritory'
            ),
            (
                'ambiguous_profit',
                'Profit Interpretation Policy',
                'usage_policy',
                'If a user asks for profit without defining the type, interpret it as Gross Product Profit only when the response clearly states that assumption. If the user asks for net profit, explain that AdventureWorksDW does not contain all operating expenses required to calculate true net profit.',
                'SalesAmount - TotalProductCost',
                'dbo.FactInternetSales'
            )
    ) AS g (
        term_id,
        business_term,
        term_type,
        definition,
        canonical_expression,
        relevant_tables
    )
)
SELECT
    CONCAT('glossary:', term_id) AS document_id,
    'business_glossary' AS document_type,
    'internet_sales' AS domain,
    DB_NAME() AS source_database,
    'dbo' AS schema_name,
    '' AS table_name,
    '' AS qualified_table_name,
    business_term,
    term_type,
    canonical_expression,
    relevant_tables,
    CONCAT(
        'BUSINESS TERM: ',
        business_term,
        CHAR(10),
        'TYPE: ',
        term_type,
        CHAR(10),
        'DOMAIN: Internet Sales',
        CHAR(10),
        'DEFINITION: ',
        definition,
        CHAR(10),
        'CANONICAL EXPRESSION: ',
        canonical_expression,
        CHAR(10),
        'RELEVANT TABLES: ',
        relevant_tables
    ) AS content
FROM BusinessGlossary
ORDER BY business_term;

WITH SqlExamples AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        VALUES
            (
                'total_internet_sales',
                'What is the total Internet sales revenue?',
                'aggregation',
                'dbo.FactInternetSales',
                CAST(
                    N'SELECT
    CAST(SUM(fis.SalesAmount) AS decimal(18,2)) AS InternetSalesRevenue
FROM dbo.FactInternetSales AS fis;'
                    AS nvarchar(max)
                )
            ),
            (
                'sales_by_year',
                'Show Internet sales revenue by year.',
                'time_series',
                'dbo.FactInternetSales,dbo.DimDate',
                CAST(
                    N'SELECT
    d.CalendarYear,
    CAST(SUM(fis.SalesAmount) AS decimal(18,2)) AS InternetSalesRevenue
FROM dbo.FactInternetSales AS fis
INNER JOIN dbo.DimDate AS d
    ON d.DateKey = fis.OrderDateKey
GROUP BY
    d.CalendarYear
ORDER BY
    d.CalendarYear;'
                    AS nvarchar(max)
                )
            ),
            (
                'sales_by_category',
                'Show Internet sales revenue by product category.',
                'dimensional_analysis',
                'dbo.FactInternetSales,dbo.DimProduct,dbo.DimProductSubcategory,dbo.DimProductCategory',
                CAST(
                    N'SELECT
    pc.EnglishProductCategoryName AS ProductCategory,
    CAST(SUM(fis.SalesAmount) AS decimal(18,2)) AS InternetSalesRevenue
FROM dbo.FactInternetSales AS fis
INNER JOIN dbo.DimProduct AS p
    ON p.ProductKey = fis.ProductKey
INNER JOIN dbo.DimProductSubcategory AS ps
    ON ps.ProductSubcategoryKey = p.ProductSubcategoryKey
INNER JOIN dbo.DimProductCategory AS pc
    ON pc.ProductCategoryKey = ps.ProductCategoryKey
GROUP BY
    pc.EnglishProductCategoryName
ORDER BY
    InternetSalesRevenue DESC;'
                    AS nvarchar(max)
                )
            ),
            (
                'top_products_by_sales',
                'What are the top 10 products by Internet sales revenue?',
                'ranking',
                'dbo.FactInternetSales,dbo.DimProduct',
                CAST(
                    N'SELECT TOP (10)
    p.EnglishProductName AS ProductName,
    CAST(SUM(fis.SalesAmount) AS decimal(18,2)) AS InternetSalesRevenue
FROM dbo.FactInternetSales AS fis
INNER JOIN dbo.DimProduct AS p
    ON p.ProductKey = fis.ProductKey
GROUP BY
    p.EnglishProductName
ORDER BY
    InternetSalesRevenue DESC;'
                    AS nvarchar(max)
                )
            ),
            (
                'sales_by_territory',
                'Show Internet sales revenue by sales territory.',
                'dimensional_analysis',
                'dbo.FactInternetSales,dbo.DimSalesTerritory',
                CAST(
                    N'SELECT
    st.SalesTerritoryGroup,
    st.SalesTerritoryCountry,
    st.SalesTerritoryRegion,
    CAST(SUM(fis.SalesAmount) AS decimal(18,2)) AS InternetSalesRevenue
FROM dbo.FactInternetSales AS fis
INNER JOIN dbo.DimSalesTerritory AS st
    ON st.SalesTerritoryKey = fis.SalesTerritoryKey
GROUP BY
    st.SalesTerritoryGroup,
    st.SalesTerritoryCountry,
    st.SalesTerritoryRegion
ORDER BY
    InternetSalesRevenue DESC;'
                    AS nvarchar(max)
                )
            ),
            (
                'top_customers_by_sales',
                'Who are the top 10 customers by Internet sales revenue?',
                'ranking',
                'dbo.FactInternetSales,dbo.DimCustomer',
                CAST(
                    N'SELECT TOP (10)
    c.CustomerKey,
    c.FirstName,
    c.LastName,
    CAST(SUM(fis.SalesAmount) AS decimal(18,2)) AS InternetSalesRevenue
FROM dbo.FactInternetSales AS fis
INNER JOIN dbo.DimCustomer AS c
    ON c.CustomerKey = fis.CustomerKey
GROUP BY
    c.CustomerKey,
    c.FirstName,
    c.LastName
ORDER BY
    InternetSalesRevenue DESC;'
                    AS nvarchar(max)
                )
            ),
            (
                'order_count_by_year',
                'Show the number of Internet orders by year.',
                'time_series',
                'dbo.FactInternetSales,dbo.DimDate',
                CAST(
                    N'SELECT
    d.CalendarYear,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fis.SalesOrderNumber) AS InternetOrderCount
FROM dbo.FactInternetSales AS fis
INNER JOIN dbo.DimDate AS d
    ON d.DateKey = fis.OrderDateKey
GROUP BY
    d.CalendarYear
ORDER BY
    d.CalendarYear;'
                    AS nvarchar(max)
                )
            ),
            (
                'gross_profit_by_category',
                'Show gross product profit by product category.',
                'dimensional_analysis',
                'dbo.FactInternetSales,dbo.DimProduct,dbo.DimProductSubcategory,dbo.DimProductCategory',
                CAST(
                    N'SELECT
    pc.EnglishProductCategoryName AS ProductCategory,
    CAST(
        SUM(fis.SalesAmount - fis.TotalProductCost)
        AS decimal(18,2)
    ) AS GrossProductProfit
FROM dbo.FactInternetSales AS fis
INNER JOIN dbo.DimProduct AS p
    ON p.ProductKey = fis.ProductKey
INNER JOIN dbo.DimProductSubcategory AS ps
    ON ps.ProductSubcategoryKey = p.ProductSubcategoryKey
INNER JOIN dbo.DimProductCategory AS pc
    ON pc.ProductCategoryKey = ps.ProductCategoryKey
GROUP BY
    pc.EnglishProductCategoryName
ORDER BY
    GrossProductProfit DESC;'
                    AS nvarchar(max)
                )
            ),
            (
                'average_order_value',
                'What is the average Internet order value?',
                'aggregation',
                'dbo.FactInternetSales',
                CAST(
                    N'SELECT
    CAST(
        SUM(fis.SalesAmount)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT fis.SalesOrderNumber), 0)
        AS decimal(18,2)
    ) AS AverageOrderValue
FROM dbo.FactInternetSales AS fis;'
                    AS nvarchar(max)
                )
            )
    ) AS e (
        example_id,
        example_question,
        analysis_type,
        relevant_tables,
        sql_query
    )
)
SELECT
    CONCAT('sql-example:', example_id) AS document_id,
    'sql_example' AS document_type,
    'internet_sales' AS domain,
    DB_NAME() AS source_database,
    'dbo' AS schema_name,
    '' AS table_name,
    '' AS qualified_table_name,
    example_question,
    analysis_type,
    relevant_tables,
    sql_query,
    CONCAT(
        'VERIFIED SQL EXAMPLE',
        CHAR(10),
        'QUESTION: ',
        example_question,
        CHAR(10),
        'DOMAIN: Internet Sales',
        CHAR(10),
        'ANALYSIS TYPE: ',
        analysis_type,
        CHAR(10),
        'RELEVANT TABLES: ',
        relevant_tables,
        CHAR(10),
        'SQL DIALECT: Microsoft T-SQL',
        CHAR(10),
        'SQL:',
        CHAR(10),
        sql_query
    ) AS content
FROM SqlExamples
ORDER BY example_id;
